title: Compute Alternating Sum
description:
You are given an array nums.

Compute the alternating sum:

nums[0] - nums[1] + nums[2] - nums[3] + ...
Rule
Add elements at even indices (0, 2, 4, …)
Subtract elements at odd indices (1, 3, 5, …)
Task

Return the final alternating sum.

Examples

Example 1

[1,3,5,7]
→ -4

Example 2

[100]
→ 100
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
